data.one_liner: Writes mindful minutes to Apple Health on iOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter plugin that checks and requests HealthKit write permission and saves a mindful‑minutes session to Apple Health. On non‑iOS platforms the methods simply return false.
use_when: You need to record mindful minutes in Apple Health on iOS devices
Your app already targets iOS 15+ and uses HealthKit for write‑only data
avoid_when: You need cross‑platform health data support
Your app runs on Android or other non‑iOS platforms
strengths: Simple, focused API for writing minutes
Supports both Swift Package Manager and CocoaPods
Handles permission flow and error propagation
weaknesses: iOS‑only; returns false on other platforms
data.setup_notes: Add HealthKit capability in Xcode, include NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription in Info.plist, optionally configure Swift Package Manager via flutter config, ensure iOS deployment target >=15.
